universities.name: \. University of Gothenburg
universities.desc: **Bachelor's:** The university offers a Computer Science and AI bachelor's programme taught in English, with an Autumn 2027 start. The programme covers computer science and artificial intelligence. **Master's:** The university also offers an English-taught master's programme in Computer Science, allowing students to explore advanced computing subjects. **Location:** Gothenburg, Sweden **![][image1]**

universities.name: \. KTH Royal Institute of Technology
universities.location: \. KTH Royal Institute of Technology, Sweden
universities.desc: **Master's:** KTH offers an MSc in Computer Science, covering advanced areas such as algorithms, artificial intelligence, computer security, networks, software technology and data science. KTH is a relevant option for graduates seeking in-depth technical knowledge and research-oriented projects. **Location:** Stockholm, Sweden **![][image2]**

universities.name: \. Chalmers University of Technology
universities.desc: **Master's:** Chalmers offers an MSc in Computer Science, with subjects including computational logic, algorithms, formal methods and reliable software. The university also offers an MSc in Computing Systems, with specialisation opportunities in high-performance computing, distributed systems, networks and cybersecurity. **Location:** Gothenburg, Sweden **![][image3]** **Important programme distinction:** The University of Gothenburg has an English-taught bachelor's option in Computer Science and AI listed for Autumn 2027\. The other universities mentioned above are relevant master's options in this guide. Their bachelor's programmes may be taught in Swedish or have different degree titles. Always check the language of instruction and current programme availability.

items.q: Can Indian students apply for Computer Science in Sweden?
items.a: Yes, Indian students with qualifying credentials meeting English language proficiency (IELTS/TOEFL) and academic prerequisites can apply to recognized universities in Sweden.

items.q: What is the medium of instruction for Computer Science in Sweden?
items.a: Most master's and international bachelor's degree programmes are taught entirely in English for international students across Swedish universities.

items.q: What are the typical tuition fees for Computer Science in Sweden?
items.a: Tuition fees for international students generally range between SEK 80,000 and SEK 150,000 per year, depending on the institution and level of study.

items.q: Can international students work while studying in Sweden?
items.a: Yes, non-EU international students holding a valid Swedish residence permit for higher education are permitted to work alongside their studies without a fixed hours limitation during term time.
